comparators.name: OpenClaw
adopt: core capability contract and vendor implementation are separate
effective tool inventory exposes incompatible or quarantined entries instead of silently hiding them
requester-scoped connection material is ephemeral, redacted, bounded, and fail-closed
doNotCopy: one new capability expanding through core registry, config, SDK, plugin, docs, and many feature consumers before one user journey proves demand
large preinstalled capability surface as the default model context

comparators.name: Hermes
adopt: catalog manifests are the single source of suggestible integrations
setup waits are scoped to the originating session and do not block other chats
a new user message can decline a parked setup instead of leaving the agent hung
untrusted local MCP entries are checked both when saved and before spawn
doNotCopy: agent-editable skills without a separate trust and promotion boundary

comparators.name: Codex
adopt: skill means reusable method and supporting resources
plugin can bundle skills and MCP-backed connected tools
a composable CLI remains a valid capability instead of requiring a new first-class tool
doNotCopy: developer-facing setup language as the general-user product surface

comparators.name: Claude Code
adopt: MCP is a standard boundary for external tools and data
remote OAuth is user-controlled and its stored authorization can be cleared
connection scope and permission are explicit
doNotCopy: requiring a general user to edit JSON, environment variables, or run MCP commands

alreadyPresent: connection truth with registered inspectors, routes, capabilities, and actions
OAuth and local-app user handoff surfaces
append-only conversation, Run, Receipt, authority, recovery, and managed-process wake
largestObservedGap: a completed connection only closes its card; it does not resume the original user goal
a local install or login action has no durable session-scoped completion handoff
connection facts are registered service by service and are not yet a general capability inventory
bundled skills can be read but no trusted acquisition or promotion path exists

nextGate.name: Goal-Preserving Capability Handoff
nextGate.firstChange: reuse connection truth and the existing wake path behind an append-only handoff state machine so verified preparation completion resumes each original conversation at most once without replaying stale authority
requiredBoundaries: automatic resume is a fresh model wake, not replay of an old tool call
waiting, readiness_observed, completion_recorded, resume_claimed, and resumed are distinct durable states
runtime inspectors poll with bounded interval and timeout while model calls remain zero until state changes
multiple sessions may wait on one connection but retain independent handoff, goal, and authority scope
